props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: className
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: aria-valuetext
props.description: A string value that provides a user-friendly name for `aria-valuenow`, the current value of the progress bar.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value. The component is indeterminate when value is `null`.

props.name: render
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.

props.name: max
props.description: The maximum value.

props.name: min
props.description: The minimum value.

props.name: locale
props.description:
The locale used by `Intl.NumberFormat` when formatting the value.
Defaults to the user's runtime locale.

props.name: format
props.description: Options to format the value.

props.name: getAriaValueText
props.type: ((formattedValue: string, value: number | null) => string) | undefined
props.description: Accepts a function which returns a string value that provides a human-readable text alternative for the current value of the progress bar.
